records.title: Large Language Model Post-Training: A Unified View of Off-Policy and On-Policy Learning
records.reason: This is a post-training survey of off-policy/on-policy behavior and distillation. Its systems-level consolidation framing is training-stage behavior transfer, not a concrete serving or inference optimization.

records.title: VideoZeroBench: Probing the Limits of Video MLLMs with Spatio-Temporal Evidence Verification
records.reason: VideoZeroBench is a long-video MLLM grounding benchmark; its contribution is evaluation of spatiotemporal evidence, not inference resource reduction.

records.title: Hidden Reliability Risks in Large Language Models: Systematic Identification of Precision-Induced Output Disagreements
records.reason: PrecisionDiff detects behavioral divergence between FP/BF and quantized precisions and localizes sensitive layers, but its purpose is safety differential testing, not a compression/latency optimization. The precision findings are relevant to quantized-inference validation but do not establish an efficiency gain, so retain as borderline.

records.title: MOON3.0: Reasoning-aware Multimodal Representation Learning for E-commerce Product Understanding
records.reason: MOON3.0 proposes a multimodal representation model and training objectives for e-commerce product understanding. It reports task performance but no inference cost savings.

records.title: Deep convolutional state space model as human activity recognizer
records.reason: The DOI/publisher article could not be retrieved and no author primary abstract/full text was accessible. The title suggests a non-LLM human-activity classifier, but this cannot be verified from primary text.
